ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF(AND(TEXT(Apttus__Status_Category__c) ='In Effect', APTS_Record_Type_Name__c = 'Frame Contract', OR(ISBLANK( Apttus__Contract_Start_Date__c), ISBLANK( Apttus__Description__c ), ISBLANK( APTS_History__c ), ISBLANK( APTS_Other_Party_Products__c ), ISBLANK( APTS_ETAS_Products__c ), ISBLANK( APTS_Agreed_Use__c ), ISBLANK( APTS_Risks__c ))), true, false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage:
Please enter the following before activating the agreement:
Agreement Start Date, Purpose, History, Other Party Products, ETAS Products, Agreed Use, Risks
Also, if the agreement is not Perpetual, then the Agreement End Date is required.
